revisions.summary: Second independent grocery source verified (Super Yuda, yuda.co.il) and the shared stor.ai/Self-Point platform mapped. No reachable permitted vendor can deliver an exact 4-10 tub batch to Tel Aviv–Yafo because every reachable vendor's published minimum order exceeds the batch item total; the low-minimum chains are blocked by bot protection or vendor terms.

Re-checked Bastale (still out of stock) and probed additional Israeli grocery domains (all blocked, terms-excluded, unrelated or unreachable). Corrected the Super Haviv finding: the tracked listing IS carried at branch 3507 (₪6.50, in stock) but the branch only delivers to Petah Tikva / Kiryat Ono / Givat Shmuel, so it cannot serve the default Tel Aviv–Yafo locality. A standalone 4-10 tub batch would be purchasable there (item ₪26-₪65 + ₪34 published area delivery), which makes Petah Tikva the one concrete low-minimum locality option if the owner wants to add it; this iteration did not change the selectable destinations.

Duchan Ganei Shmuel verified as the first purchasable exact-batch source: branch 2175 carries the tracked listing at ₪6.30, its local גן שמואל area publishes ₪28 delivery with no minimum order, and anonymous public cart quotes for exact 4/6/8/10-tub batches added the ₪28 delivery line (₪53.20/₪65.80/₪78.40/₪91.00). Adapter src/vendors/duchan.js (duchan/1), fixture tests/fixtures/duchan-product.json and policy duchan-cottage-ganei-shmuel-home-delivery v1 registered; the selectable ganei-shmuel destination exposes the totals while the default Tel Aviv–Yafo locality stays unranked. Super Haviv Petah Tikva re-checked: the listing is real and a cart line activates by row id 20230801, but the delivery-applying PATCH is Radware-blocked and the published minimum statements conflict (area ₪10 vs terms ₪200), so it stays unranked. Cart-line identity learning: stor.ai carts accept a listing by the row id, not the branchProductId.

Settled the Super Haviv Petah Tikva lead without ranking it: the store's own published terms (quoted in the source record) set a ₪200 site minimum and a ₪34 delivery fee, contradicting the branch area field's ₪10; every exact 4-10 tub batch (₪60.00-₪99.00 delivered) is below the terms minimum. A fresh bounded anonymous cart attempt reproduced the Radware block on the delivery-applying PATCH (third block; the delivery-line POST is accepted and the cart line activates at ₪26.00 for 4 tubs), so no cart total can be read and no ranking is claimed. Re-checked Bastale (still out of stock at ₪7.90) and Shufersal (still the 444-byte maintenance/error page from the runner, even with a browser user agent). No new reachable Tel Aviv–Yafo grocery source was found.

Owner scope narrowed to Tel Aviv–Yafo delivery only, so the re-sweep targeted Tel Aviv coverage exclusively: every previously blocked low-minimum chain (Verona Market ₪20, Twins Market ₪75, Sholik ₪80, MCK, Hinam Plus, Keshet Teamim, Victory, Mahsanei Shuk) and four not-yet-checked Tel Aviv delivery services (Zapp, Getir, Bolt Market, 10bis) were probed once each with the honest user agent. No new permitted Tel Aviv–Yafo source: the low-minimum chains are unreachable/challenged, Getir and Zapp are unreachable/challenged, Bolt Market and 10bis expose no Israeli grocery interface, and Wolt/Yango Deli stay terms-excluded. Duchan was not refreshed or expanded (out of the active registry and out of the authorized locality). The deployed public site was then verified read-only: the production probe passes (published runner-research rows keep their recorded times and failed live checks; the four Tel Aviv batches stay unranked with their exact minimum-order reasons) and an offline-browser live run of the real public pages passed 129/129 checks at 1440×1000 and 390×844 with zero JavaScript errors, natively inspected from saved captures.
